name: Rio Rollins Tachibana
original_name: リオ・ロリンズ・タチバナ
source:
It is no exaggeration to say that she was the spark that ignited the moefication of the pachinko industry.

She's as revolutionary to the pachinko industry like Katsuya Nomura was to Japanese baseball.

She is the mascot to a series of pachinko games by Temco. She also features as the main heroine in the anime named after her, Rio: Rainbow Gate!

[From [url=https://www.konbuni.com/nangoku.html]official site[/url]]
